title: Disney Adventure Cruise from Singapore
alt: Family cruise ship sailing out of Singapore at sunset
transport: Private airport and cruise terminal transfers

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Children stop asking what is next on this one. Everything is on board and all of it is included in the fare.
expert.tip: Register the children at the Oceaneer Club on the first afternoon. Slots for the themed sessions fill up fast once the ship sails.

summary: Four days on the Disney Adventure out of Singapore. Three nights in an inside stateroom with every meal included, themed zones across the decks, shows at the Walt Disney Theatre and character meetings through the day.
included: Included: 3 nights aboard the Disney Adventure in an inside stateroom with breakfast, lunch and dinner; the themed immersive zones; shows at the Walt Disney Theatre; the Avengers deck show; private transfers between Changi Airport and the cruise terminal.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; port charges and gratuities; speciality dining, the spa and paid activities on board; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: A day of rides and shows

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the cruise terminal
Board the Disney Adventure and settle into your inside stateroom
Lunch on board, then the first walk through the themed zones
Dinner at the Animators Palette and a film under the stars
2: Breakfast on board, then the Ironcycle test run for the older children
Toy Story Palace and WayFinder Bay through the morning
Marvel Landing in the afternoon with character meetings
An evening show at the Walt Disney Theatre
3: Breakfast on board and a slower morning
Oceaneer Club sessions for the children while the adults take the Rainforest spa
San Fransokyo Street and the Imagination Garden after lunch
The Avengers deck show in the evening
4: Breakfast on board and disembark at the cruise terminal
Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Disney Adventure
stops.hotel: Inside Stateroom, The Disney Adventure Cruise in Singapore
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast, lunch and dinner included · Inside stateroom · Disney Adventure, sailing from Singapore

program.name: Three nights of Disney at sea
program.description: Themed zones from Toy Story to Marvel, theatre shows every evening, kids clubs by age group and all main meals in the fare.

activities.name: Disney Immersive Zones
activities.description: Seven themed districts across the decks, from Disney classics to Pixar and Marvel, open to every guest on board.

activities.name: Shows at the Walt Disney Theatre
activities.description: Full stage productions with live orchestra in the ship's main theatre, a different show each evening.

activities.name: Avengers Assemble Show
activities.description: A stunt and effects show on the open deck built around the Marvel characters, staged after sunset.

activities.name: Oceaneer Club
activities.description: Supervised play spaces split by age, with themed sessions, crafts and games through the day.

activities.name: Rainforest Spa
activities.description: Heated loungers, steam rooms and treatment cabins for the adults, booked on board.
